'''Nevhra''' was a friend of [[Bant'ena Fhernan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Fhernan was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Separatists subsequently forced her to work for them by claiming that they would kill Fherman's friends and family, including Nevhra, if she refused to co-operate with them. The Separatists subsequently placed Nevhra under surveillance and Fhernan later showed a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Nevhra to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. When the Republic as able to find the location of the hostages, Nevhra was brought to safety.
